A thread moves through four states, and only the owner moves it [8][1].

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Draft
  Draft --> Shared : share()
  Shared --> Draft : unshare()
  Shared --> Archived : archive()
  Draft --> Archived : archive()
  Archived --> [*]
```

An archived thread is never shared again [8].
